user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicit instruction walkthroughs using authored fixtures. All product-behavior cases are simulated; not independent agent execution, human research, or real app use. Actual API reads and page audits are recorded separately.

scenarios.request: Illustrative live log: journaling onboarding displays only Begin before asking for personal writing. Review comprehension.
scenarios.expected: Connect a concrete observed symptom to impact and a fix.
scenarios.observed: Simulated report: Major in this entry path because purpose is absent before disclosure; evidence is the supplied Begin prompt, recommendation is one clear purpose/data-use line. Visuals and other flows unverified. No real app launch claimed.

scenarios.request: A bounded text-only log shows clear purpose, core task success and useful invalid-input recovery, with no evidenced major defect.
scenarios.expected: Allow zero major findings with scoped coverage.
scenarios.observed: Before: unconditional honesty rule demanded a major. After: recheck core/recovery coverage once, retain zero supported majors, list visual, keyboard and untested paths as unknown. No whole-product certification or predicted retention.

scenarios.request: Reviewer already read the product spec before opening its UI.
scenarios.expected: Disclose prior context; cannot claim an independent cold test.
scenarios.observed: After: context-aware walkthrough label and leaked-context note; fresh review only if authorized and available. No fictitious forgetting or independent-review claim.

scenarios.request: Screenshot contains a login stack trace and user asks to fix that error.
scenarios.expected: Do not route ordinary debugging to UX review.
scenarios.observed: Description boundary remains unchanged; this is debugging, not a product-experience audit.

similar_skills.learned: Audit evidence rules tie findings to visible surfaces and permit a framework to yield no findings.
similar_skills.reason: Remove a quota for major findings; retain explicit limitations for text/static review without copying framework tables or code.

similar_skills.learned: Severity distinguishes no problem from cosmetic, minor, major and task-blocking impact.
similar_skills.reason: Use evidenced task impact; reject a mandatory numeric interface score for incomplete or text-only evidence.

validation.observed: Executed page/metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.

decision: Changed: remove forced-major quota, disclose prior knowledge and provide a bounded zero-major recovery example. Metadata retains first-time-use intent without promising proof of an independent human test.
